item.title: Ibanez Upgrades the SR500 for 2026 with MR5S Bridge, Bartolini & Nordstrand Pickup Options
item.description: Ibanez updates its SR500 series for 2026 with the SR500A and SR500N, featuring the MR5S Mono Rail bridge, Bartolini or Nordstrand pickups, and models starting at $699.

item.title: CKY Bassist Mike Leon Exits Band, Cites “Toxicity” and “Unprofessionalism”
item.description: Mike Leon has exited CKY just weeks before a scheduled tour, citing toxicity and unprofessionalism in a candid statement. No replacement has been announced.

item.title: The Who at Tanglewood 1970: The Original Lineup with Entwistle’s Thunder and Moon’s Mayhem
item.description: Watch The Who’s original lineup power through a full 1970 Tanglewood set, featuring John Entwistle’s massive tone and Keith Moon’s explosive drive.

item.title: Switching to 5-String Bass: Technique Changes, Low B Strategy & Rethinking the Fretboard
item.description: Thinking about switching to a 5-string bass? This lesson breaks down right- and left-hand technique changes, low B strategy, smarter root–fifth positioning, and how to reset your fretboard reference points.

item.title: Les Claypool Announces New Claypool Lennon Delirium Album, Shares “Golden Egg of Empathy”
item.description: Les Claypool calls it the most labor-intensive record of his career. The Claypool Lennon Delirium return with a new concept album and summer tour.

item.title: Les Claypool and Sean Lennon Team with WILLOW for New Single “The Golden Egg of Empathy”
item.description: Les Claypool, Sean Lennon and WILLOW release the animated video for “The Golden Egg of Empathy,” a playful, bass driven single from the Claypool Lennon Delirium.

item.title: Ernie Ball Launches New Tapewound Bass Strings for Warm, Upright-Style Tone
item.description: Ernie Ball has unveiled new Tapewound Bass Strings featuring a black nylon wrap for a warm, mellow, upright-style tone. Available in long and short scale sets.

item.title: Dan Briggs and Between the Buried and Me Reveal 2026 U.S. Tour Dates
item.description: Between the Buried and Me have announced a 31-date U.S. tour in support of "The Blue Nowhere". See all the dates and watch Dan Briggs perform “God Terror” live.

item.title: MonoNeon and GHOST-NOTE Deliver Wild 2019 “Smack Em” Performance
item.description: A two minute solo from MonoNeon sets the tone before GHOST-NOTE kicks into a deep, high energy groove at this 2019 festival set.

item.title: Horace Panter’s “Ghost Town” 1971 Fender Precision Heads to Auction
item.description: Horace Panter’s 1971 Fender Precision, used to record The Specials’ “Ghost Town,” is headed to auction with an estimated £10K–£20K sale price.
